Synonym: SJ 8, San Jiao 8, TB 8, TH 8, TW 8, Triple Burner 8, Triple Energizer 8, Triple Heater 8, Triple Warmer 8
Location:
On the posterior aspect of the forearm, midpoint of the interosseous space between the radius and the ulna, 4 B-cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease.
 - Note: At the junction of the upper two thirds and lower one third of the line connecting TE 4 with the tip of the elbow.
Locational_Anatomy: forelimb zeugopod (radius bone, ulna, dorsal wrist crease, elbow)
Acupuncture_Method: Puncture perpendicularly 0.5-1.0 inch. Moxibustion is applicable.
Indications: pain in the chest, pain in the hypochondriac region, pain in the arm, deafness, toothache, sudden hoarseness of the voice, pain in the hand
Vasculature: The posterior antebrachial interosseous artery and vein.
